reviews.title: Don’t bother
reviews.text: Very disappointing fee-charging app that has a clunky interface, poor filtering options, prompts you towards sponsored restaurants miles from your location and is happy to rely on very out of date customer reviews… meaning restaurants are often long-closed

reviews.title: OMG - from great to disaster
reviews.text:
I loved this app for many years and contributed a lot to restaurants and vegan places. Now the app has forgotten my account (“user does not exist”). 
There is no service and feedback existing, it is like a black box for every message to the provider of Happy. 
So the best days of HappyCow are over, I guess we have another dying app here.

reviews.title: Deleted my review while I was writing it, no iPad or Mac support
reviews.text:
If you’re writing a review and accidentally swipe down from the center of the screen, it deletes your review and there’s no place to retrieve it. So instead of writing a review for their platform, I’m writing this one star review instead. I’m sure they’ll reply to this when the bug is fixed. I’m very annoyed.

Secondly, the “iPad version” (if you can call it that with a straight face) doesn’t support landscape AND they block this app from running on macOS. 

The app developers give vegans a bad name by being not only controlling, but highly incompetent.

reviews.title: Veraltete Infos, schlechter Support
reviews.text: Sehr viele Einträge sind nicht mehr aktuell, ich habe mehrere Updates vor Ewigkeiten hinzugefügt, es tut sich nichts. Sehr frustrierend.

reviews.title: Useful, but IMO needs serious improvement
reviews.text: First there is the issue of not having a lot of useful information in areas that are not that popular, though I do understand that it’s community driven so I can’t complain too much about it. But this app is really not great to use. I zoom in to an area of interest and hit “search here” and it zooms way out to an area that is 100 times larger. Every time when you tap on a place it centers the map there. That is not great, I am typically interested in a particular area and I only want to explore the places there, with this behavior I have to re-center the map all the time. And browsing through the restaurants by sliding left and right the options at the bottom is just terrible, no idea what order they are in (certainly not distance), swipe right and I am now on the other side of Bangkok. I actually take the time to input a range of these places in Google Maps and then it’s usable. In this era of AI coding it should be trivial to make this a more usable experience.

reviews.text: Very unhappy that I’ve had no support when logging in. Keep changing the password and I’m still not able to have full access to the app. Will be asking for my money back if I’m not ignored.

reviews.title: Closed restaurants and overcharged
reviews.text: The App Store indicated the app was 4.99, fine, but then I was charged over $38, WTAF. I started using it and one of the first restaurants on the list has been closed for years with another restaurant in its place, so I’m assuming at least in my area this is useless. What a rip off

reviews.text: Unable to find a method to unsubscribe.. not great

reviews.title: Dead App
reviews.text: I've been a HappyCow user for almost 10 years with over 1000 points. Listings are outdated and/or contain incorrect information. A quick Google search is more accurate. Want to add a new listing or correct false information? Cool, your request will sit in a queue and never be approved. The community is TRYING to maintain the website/app and there is 0 response. This is just pathetic. I also tried to leave a review but it said I didn't "own" the app. So I deleted and it said I needed to pay $4.99. Hilarious. And I did, just so I could tell you how bad this has gotten. Try a different app like Spinach or stick to Google.

reviews.title: Not reliable
reviews.text: Bought the App as currently travelling in Vietnam & so far it’s not good. You can only use it around your current location, not for research before going any places. That is a big NO. Also location and information are outdated or simple incorrect, ie restaurants have never been there or exists but 25km away or have been closed since over 5 years. No reporting function available. For an App you have to pay for, this is very poor. Safe your money &!just use Google or similar.

reviews.title: used to be a good app but no longer updated
reviews.text: i’ve been submitting new listings that aren’t being approved for 8+ months. i can’t rely on an app for finding food when travelling if they aren’t listing restaurants in a reasonable time. they need to expand their moderation team or this app will become irrelevant

reviews.title: Updates marginal
reviews.text:
We try to make updates on a regular basis, but restaurants are not updated with menu,  hours, or still vegan options.
We’ve suggested a new category: whole food plant based over 2 years ago, nothing.

reviews.title: Annoyed I spent money on this
reviews.text: The filtering is non existent. You can’t filter by vegetarian options available or open now. It’s clunky and I found it unusable during my trip to Japan. Opened it twice and was so frustrated by the experience I didn’t use it again.
